thread:
jess: quick design sync — UX nit: when a streamed reply is 'paused' the affordance reads 'Pause' but behavior is more of a soft-hold (client keeps connection). Can we clarify copy?
sophia: agreed. 'Pause' implies you can resume from exact spot. We're not preserving partial tokens for resume right now. maybe 'Hold' vs 'Pause'?
matt: from infra side we keep the stream open for 10s after a pause. resume isn't guaranteed after that. so copy should set expectation.
anya: proposal: show primary CTA as 'Pause output' and secondary as 'Stop generation' — with a tooltip explaining resume behavior. tooltip: "Pauses visual updates for 10s; partial context not preserved after 10s. Use Stop to terminate generation and free compute." thoughts?
jess: I like the two-verb approach. Need microcopy to be short in mobile. 'Pause updates' / 'Stop & release' maybe.
ux-bot: accessibility flag: buttons need aria-labels that include state e.g., `aria-pressed` for paused. keyboard shortcut recommended: `Esc` to soft-stop, `Shift+Esc` to hard-stop.
matt: can confirm `Esc` is unused in current composer; perf-wise soft-stop maps to sending a cancel token to the runtime which still keeps KV cache.
sophia: token counter discussion: current mock shows "298 tokens" as live count. designers want cumulative vs visible tokens. Use two modes: "visible tokens" (what user sent + response) and "session tokens" (total for chat).
anya: Mode toggle seems heavy. What if counter shows primary number and small chevron that expands to session breakdown? default compact: response tokens (live) and total on expansion.
jess: good. Also add aria-live region for counter updates, but rate-limit announcements to every 1s to avoid screen reader spam.
matt: backend: we can emit token deltas with stream chunks; throttle to 1s server-side. fine.
sophia: prompt library: current layout pins prompt drawer to right and collapses to icons only. feedback: frequent users want 'pin to top' of library for favorites and drag-to-insert into composer.
anya: propose 'collections' at top of drawer, collapse icon-only for low-usage. also a 'quick-insert' hover that shows 2-line preview.
jess: UX nit: keyboard nav inside prompt library should use arrow keys + typeahead. screen reader should announce preview title and tags.
ux-bot: a11y test note: ensure color contrast of token-pill badges >= 4.5:1. test with tokens count badge on dark bg.
matt: small dev detail: when inserting a prompt from library while a stream is in-flight we should either queue the prompt or warn user losing current output. prefer warning toast: "New prompt will cancel current generation — Continue? [Cancel] [Insert and Cancel]".
sophia: microcopy for that toast: short and direct. suggestion: "Inserting this prompt will stop the current response. Insert anyway?"
anya: will add copy options to Figma. I'll also add a tiny animation spec for pause -> stop transition to make it feel less jarring.
jess: final asks for this thread: 1) change 'Pause' to 'Pause updates' in designs, 2) compact token counter with expandable breakdown, 3) prompt library favorites + quick-insert preview, 4) ARIA and keyboard accessibility checklist from ux-bot. i'll file a follow-up PR with copy variants.
matt: I'll stub the server-side throttle and cancel semantics this week.
sophia: I'll update Figma and post screenshots later.
anya: adding checklist to the design task. ping me if anyone wants to pair on the accessibility items.
jess: thanks all :heart:
